description: Moves a whole Gmail conversation to Trash: every message in the thread, in one call. Takes the thread ID. The messages leave the inbox and every other label view and stay in Trash, where Gmail deletes them for good after 30 days; gmail_untrash_thread restores them before then. Returns the thread ID and, for each message in it, the message ID and whether it is now in Trash.

account.description: Optional email address of the connected account to use (e.g. 'user@gmail.com'). If omitted, the default account is used.

thread_id.description: The ID of the thread to move to Trash, as gmail_search, gmail_list and gmail_read return it (threadId).

name: gws-mcp__gmail_trash_thread
